pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-06.png with Read and looked at it. Panel 1 (top left): the white caption 'Tomorrow, care may take us beyond our hometown.' sits beside Ravi's box. Panel 2 (top right): the teal label 'WELBUK VISION' is at top left, the specialist's box is upper right, and the white caption at the bottom reads 'The vision: trusted connections between clinics, specialists, and patients across locations.' Panel 3 (wide, middle): the teal label 'WELBUK VISION' appears again, followed by the white caption 'One connected ecosystem for care and family wellness.' Ravi, a partner and a child are to the right. Panel 4 (large, bottom): Meera, Ananya and Ravi stand in a row; Ravi's label is cut to 'rav' by the teal box. The teal box at top right reads 'Welbuk Practice • Welbuk Care • Welbuk Health', and the white caption at bottom left reads 'Welbuk — Building a connected healthcare ecosystem.' The page has no spoken dialogue.
pages.observation: 1) 'Tomorrow' is ambiguous: it could mean the literal next day or the future. 'us' and 'our hometown' have no clear speaker. Because the caption sits beside Ravi, it could be read as his inner voice or as a narrator. 2) The partner and the child appear here for the first time on pages 2 to 6, with no introduction. 3) The specialist's location ('beyond our hometown', 'across locations') is not shown. 4) The 'WELBUK VISION' label is repeated in panels 2 and 3, which feels redundant. 5) In panel 4 I read the teal product list (top right) before the bottom-left caption. That order works, but the teal box covers Ravi's label and possibly his face area. 6) The whole page is captions and product labels with no dialogue. It reads as an advertisement ending, not a story beat for the characters.
